biography.value: Dark Stalkers are the first Shadow creature with genuine tactical sophistication. They manage their Planar Steps as resources — one to open with Shadow Ambush from an unexpected angle, one held for extraction when the engagement turns unfavorable. Death Sense ensures they always know which target is most vulnerable. Shadow Form in darkness gives them DR 8 against mundane ### Attacks, making them effectively immune to conventional weapons while in their preferred environment. A summoner who controls lighting conditions — ensuring the engagement happens in dim light or darkness — will find a Dark Stalker performs at well above its TR. The creature is also the first Shadow creature that actively evaluates when retreat serves its interests better than continued engagement, which it will execute without prompting if the tactical situation warrants it.

system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 120 ft, Devil's Sight, See Invisibility
system.attacksNotes:
Shadow Blade [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 4), Reach: 5 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 9 damage (5 + 4 Str) + 3 Negative damage (Ignore DR); target loses 3 from Current Luck.
  • Margin 2: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 Negative damage; Current Luck reduced by 4; target Disoriented + Dazed until end of their next turn; no save.
  • Margin 3: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 Negative damage; Current Luck reduced by 5; Disoriented + Dazed; target makes Will save (1 success) or Frightened until end of their next.

Shadow Bolt [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 3), Range: 60 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 11 Negative damage (8 + 3 Dex); target loses 2 from Current Luck.
  • Margin 2: 11 Negative damage, DR halved (round up) + Disoriented until end of their next turn; Current Luck reduced by 3; no save.
  • Margin 3: 11 Negative damage, DR halved (round up) + Dazed for 1 minute; Current Luck reduced by 4; Will save each round to end.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Shadow Form: While in dim light or darkness, DR increases to 8 against all non-magical damage and non-Positive energy damage. Positive energy ignores this entirely. Planar Step (2/short rest): As a [Move] action, steps briefly into the Shadow Plane and re-emerges up to 30 feet away in any dim or dark location it can see. Does not provoke opportunity ### Attacks. Cannot be used in bright light. Devil's Sight: Sees through magical darkness as if bright light. Death Sense: Automatically detects creatures below half HP within 60 feet and knows their precise location regardless of concealment or invisibility. Shadow Ambush: When the Dark Stalker ### Attacks on the same turn it used Planar Step, it has Fortune on that attack.
